newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraqi minister back from Jordan after surgery.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi minister back from Jordan after surgery.

text.p: Iraqi Defence Minister General Sultan Hashim Ahmed has returned home after successful surgery in Amman, Baghdad radio said on Sunday.
"Defence Minister General Sultan Hashim Ahmed has returned to Baghdad after undergoing successful surgery in the Jordanian capital Amman," the radio said.
Iraqi media have identified General Abdel-Jabbar Shanshal, the minister of state for military affairs, as acting minister of defence during Ahmed's absence.
